name: AD820 / AD822 / AD824 (ADI single-supply rail-to-rail-output JFET-input)
tagline: Low-power ADI JFET-input op amps with rail-to-rail outputs for single-supply use. Japanese DIY builders use the AD822 in battery CMoy amps and compare its sound to the OPA2134.
technology: JFET-input precision op amps (1/2/4 channels) with rail-to-rail output and an input range that extends below the negative rail. AD820: 5 V to 36 V single or ±2.5 V to ±18 V dual supply, 1.8 MHz, 3 V/µs, 800 µA max. AD822: 5 V to 30 V single or ±2.5 V to ±15 V dual, output within 10 mV of each rail. AD824: 3 V single up to ±15 V, 2 MHz, 2 V/µs, 500 µA per amplifier.

reputation.summary: The praise is modest and comes mostly from Japanese DIY sources. A zigsow review calls the AD822 'a single-supply part that holds up well enough for audio'. nabe's spec-vs-sound notes say its sound tendency is similar to the OPA2134, with a cool FET-input character, and find the OPA2350 fuller-bodied. The very low current draw makes it a battery CMoy headphone-amp choice, but nabe notes some transient problems into 15-ohm loads. Akizuki stocks the DIP version for hobbyists.
caveats: Designed as a low-power precision/instrumentation part, not an audio part
Limited drive: transient problems reported into 15-ohm headphone loads (nabe)
Praise is lukewarm ('good enough for audio'), not legendary status

silicon_changes.when: 2026 (by PCN number; exact date not confirmed)
silicon_changes.identification: Covered by ADI PCN 26_0029 Rev. -. Check the PCN for how to tell pre- and post-change parts apart (date code or other marking).
silicon_changes.summary: ADI PCN 26_0029 lists AD820, AD822 and AD824 variants together with the AD823 and AD8224 JFET-input amplifiers. Search results did not show what the change is (fab/process, assembly, test or package). A multi-product JFET-family PCN could mean a process or fab change, but that is unconfirmed.

silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: medium - a 2026 PCN covers the whole JFET-RRO family, but the nature of the change is unconfirmed

counterfeit_notes: No specific AD820/AD822/AD824 counterfeit reports were found in this check. The DIP-8 AD822ANZ circulates widely in the hobby market, so buy from authorized distributors or reputable retailers such as Akizuki.

refuted_claims: Draft 'technology' gave the whole family a 5-30 V single supply. The AD820 is specified for 5 V to 36 V (±2.5 V to ±18 V), and the AD824 for 3 V single up to ±15 V with 2 MHz, 2 V/µs and 500 µA per amplifier.
corrections: Channel counts corrected from 0 to 1 (AD820), 2 (AD822) and 4 (AD824) and to the matching ordering codes.
